{{Quote|If Yoda is indeed the Jedi warrior you believe he is, let him prove it. Allow me to send my best troops to capture him.|Asajj Ventress to King Katuunko of her confidence in T81 Division|<ref name="Ambush" />}}
'''T81 Division''' was the best [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] unit assigned to [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Ventress deployed one of its [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]]&mdash;led by two [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM commanders]], one designated [[224/Legends|224]]&mdash;to a [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], where they were [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|destroyed]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and three [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guardsmen]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:T81Division.png|thumb|left|200px|T81 Division tanks and droids organized into a column while maneuvering through Rugosa's coral moon.]]
Despite low target accuracy, the maneuverability and destructive force of T81 Division was highly rated compared to other [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Utilizing [[gray]] and [[blue]]-[[Color/Legends|striped]] [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|spider droids]] with blue [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]],<ref name="SWPM" /> the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM commander]]-led [[Division/Legends|division]] included [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]], and [[B2-HA super battle droid/Legends|B2-HA]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] with [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="Ambush" />

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA11">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> under the orders of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], the [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] ''[[L-2832]]''<ref name="Lander">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=''L-2832'' C-9979 landing craft|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw16.jpg}}</ref> deployed a T81 Division [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]<ref name="Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}}</ref> to the [[Rugosa land coral|coral]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] in a bid to convince [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of Separatist superiority, boasting her droids could capture [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]&mdash;there negotiating a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Toydaria system/Legends|system]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] presence. Led by two [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM commanders]], the battalion had difficulty navigating through coral, compelling the commander designated [[224/Legends|224]] to abandon the AATs.<ref name="Ambush" /><ref name="Guide" /> [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guardsmen]] "[[Rys/Legends|Rys]]," "[[Jek/Legends|Jek]]," and [[Thire/Legends|CC-4477]] then helped Yoda rout them.<ref name="Ambush" /> After losing the battalion, Ventress retreated.<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Following T81 Division's [[July 26]], [[2008]] debut in ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''[[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|'': Clone Wars'']],<ref name="SWPM" /> one of its battalions appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television]] episode, "[[Ambush]]," which aired [[October 3]].<ref name="Guide" />
